refusal: Coffee Guru has no workforce management integration. There is no roster, no timesheet and no employee roll in the warehouse for its 19 venues, so wage cost, labour margin and sales per labour hour cannot be computed — not approximated, not estimated. The POS side alone would answer who sells most, and this build does not publish that on its own: a raw sales total ranks people by the hours they were rostered, which is a roster report wearing a performance label.
